import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] gridA = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] gridB = new char[12][12];
    static int n, T;
    static boolean[][][][][] _dp = new boolean[70][12][12][12][12];
    static boolean[][][][] reach = new boolean[12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dist = new int[12][12];

    static class State {
        int tt, x, y, x0, y0;
        State(int tt, int x, int y, int x0, int y0) {
            this.tt = tt;
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.x0 = x0;
            this.y0 = y0;
        }
    }

    static void computeReach(int sx, int sy) {
        if (T >= 70) return;
        if (gridA[sx][sy] < '0' || gridA[sx][sy] > '9') return;
        Stack<State> st = new Stack<>();
        st.push(new State(0, sx, sy, sx, sy));
        while (!st.isEmpty()) {
            State cur = st.pop();
            int tt = cur.tt, x = cur.x, y = cur.y, x0 = cur.x0, y0 = cur.y0;
            if (x < 0 || x >= n || y < 0 || y >= n) continue;
            if (gridA[x][x] < '0' || gridA[x][x] > '9') continue;
            if (tt > T + 1) continue;
            if (_dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0]) continue;
            if (tt > dist[x][y] && dist[x][y] != 0) continue;
            if (tt == dist[x][y] && dist[x][y] != 0 && (gridB[x][y] > '9' || gridB[x][y] <= '0')) continue;
            _dp[tt][x][y][x0][y0] = true;
            if (tt <= T) reach[x][y][x0][y0] = true;
            if (tt < dist[x][y]) {
                // push successors in reverse order to mimic recursion
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y - 1, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y + 1, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x - 1, y, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x + 1, y, x0, y0));
                st.push(new State(tt + 1, x, y, x0, y0));
            }
        }
    }

    // Dinic
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev, cap;
        Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> dinicG;
    static int dinicN;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        dinicG.get(u).add(new Edge(v, dinicG.get(v).size(), cap));
        dinicG.get(v).add(new Edge(u, dinicG.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
    }

    static int dinicBFS(int s, int t, int[] level) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        level[s] = 0;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : dinicG.get(v)) {
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                q.add(e.to);
            }
        }
        return level[t] >= 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }

    static int dinicDFS(int v, int t, int f, int[] level, int[] iter) {
        if (v == t) return f;
        for (int i = iter[v]; i < dinicG.get(v).size(); i++) {
            Edge e = dinicG.get(v).get(i);
        if (e.cap > 0 && level[v] < level[e.to]) {
            int d = dinicDFS(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap), level, iter);
            if (d > 0) {
                e.cap -= d;
                dinicG.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += d;
                return d;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
        int flow = 0;
        int[] level = new int[dinicN);
        int[] iter = new int[dinicN);
        while (dinicBFS(s, t, level) {
            Arrays.fill(iter, 0);
        int f;
        while ((f = dinicDFS(s, t, 1000000000, level, iter)) > 0) {
            flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridA[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                gridB[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }

        // BFS for distances
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                dist[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    dist[i][j] = 0;
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        int[] di = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
        int[] dj = {0, -1, 0, 1};
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            if (dist[p[0]][p[1]] >= T) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = p[0] + di[d];
                int nj = p[1] + dj[d];
                if (ni >= 0 && ni < n && nj >= 0 && nj < n &&
                    gridA[ni][nj] >= '0' && gridA[ni][nj] <= '9' && dist[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    dist[ni][nj] = dist[p[0]][p[1]] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (dist[i][j] == -1)
                dist[i][j] = T;
        }

        // Compute reachability
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] >= '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9')
                    computeReach(i, j);
            }
        }

        // Build graph
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> G = new ArrayList<>();
        int[][] C = new int[210][210];
        int[] E = new int[210];
        int[][] nodeB = new int[11][11];
        ArrayList<Integer> st = new ArrayList<>();
        G.add(st);
        for (int i1 = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (gridA[i][j] > '0' && gridA[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int k = G.size();
                    ArrayList<Integer> g = new ArrayList<>();
                    G.add(g);
                    E[k] = gridA[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
                        for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                            if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9')
                                if (reach[i2][j2][i1][j1]) {
                                    int _k;
                                    if (nodeB[i2][j2] == 0) {
                                        ArrayList<Integer> _g = new ArrayList<>();
                                        _k = G.size();
                                        G.add(_g);
                                        nodeB[i2][j2] = _k;
                                    } else {
                                        _k = nodeB[i2][j2];
                                    }
                                    G.get(k).add(_k);
                                    G.get(_k).add(k);
                                    C[k][_k] = 10000;
                                    C[_k][k] = 0;
                                }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i2 = 0; i2 < n; i2++) {
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 < n; j2++) {
                if (gridB[i2][j2] > '0' && gridB[i2][j2] <= '9' && nodeB[i2][j2] > 0) {
                    int _k = nodeB[i2][j2];
                    G.get(_k).add(0);
                    C[_k][0] = gridB[i2][j2] - '0';
                    C[0][_k] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        // Build Dinic graph
        dinicN = G.size() + 1;
        dinicG = new ArrayList<>(dinicN);
        for (int i = 0; i < dinicN; i++) {
            dinicG.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int S = G.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < G.size(); i++) {
            for (int j : G.get(i)) {
                if (C[i][j] > 0) {
                    addEdge(i, j, C[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < G.size(); i++) {
            if (E[i] > 0) {
                addEdge(S, i, E[i]);
            }
        }
        int flow = maxFlow(S, 0);
        System.out.println(flow);
    }
}
